content_patterns: Single search field filters list ('Search categories...'). Categories listed alphabetically as icon + label rows; the default 'General' row carries a 'SYSTEM' tag and padlock to signal it is protected/non-deletable. Floating verb-first CTA '+ Add Category' anchored at bottom. No per-row chevrons — rows appear to be the edit surface themselves.
notable_interactions: Search input implies filtering the category list. Padlock on 'General' implies disabled editing/deletion for system categories while others are editable (tap-to-edit implied). Floating 'Add Category' button implies a creation flow (likely modal or new screen); it overlays/cuts off the last visible row, indicating fixed positioning over scrolling content. Back arrow implies return to Settings.
